reason: A DeepSeek Harness interface customization plugin that applies translucent styling, provides a transparency slider, and supports custom page backgrounds from local images or URLs.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供液态玻璃界面主题、自定义透明度调节和本地或 URL 背景图设置。
summaries.en: Adds a liquid-glass theme to DeepSeek Harness with adjustable transparency and support for local or URL-based page backgrounds.

capabilities: Modifies the DeepSeek Harness interface appearance through theme token overrides
Adjusts shell transparency with a user-controlled slider
Displays a user-provided local image or URL as a page background
Stores preferences and compressed local images in browser localStorage
